text: fileJobState: queued→cancelled throws (not in the sidecar transition table). The manager must decide how to cancel a queued job (e.g. start→cancel, or never expose queued).

Overwrite is not atomic: createWriteStream truncates the destination on open, so a cancel mid-overwrite destroys the original (data loss; conflicts with FR-FOP-005 'only the half-written file is removed'). Write to a temp sibling and rename over the destination on success; on cancel unlink only the temp.

FR-FOP-002 AC-3 test gap: the 1 MiB adapter test does not prove onBytes fires BEFORE the copy completes (its name claims it). Tighten: record whether the destination is still incomplete / the promise unresolved at the time of the 2nd onBytes.
runJob never validates spec.sources — the route/manager must (IR-FOP-001 AC-3 source-session validation).
Duplicate or nested sources (['/a','/a/b']) are not deduplicated: totals double-count and delete ends failed. Normalize sources in the manager (drop descendants of another source, drop duplicates).
Add FR-FOP-005 AC: cancelling an overwrite keeps the original destination byte-identical (TC-REQ-FR-FOP-005-AC2-05). Consider sharpening AC-1 wording: cancel takes effect between files (AC1-03).

USER-FACING: copying a file into the folder it came from (paste in same dir) throws EINVAL instead of a conflict. Treat src===dst as a conflict whose choices are rename/skip only (no overwrite) — 'rename' yields 'name (2).ext'. Add a test.
Manager must settle the pending decide() promise when a job is cancelled (runner races decide vs signal, but the manager's decision record/resolver must be released) or the job's memory is held.
file-job:done needs affectedDirectories (IR-FOP-002 AC-4) — runner result does not carry it; manager computes it (destination dir for copy/move, source parent dirs for move/delete).

FR-FOP-004: add AC — pasting into the source's own folder (src===dst) is a conflict with choices rename/skip only; overwrite is rejected INVALID_CHOICE (TC-REQ-FR-FOP-004-AC1-04/05). Clarify AC-3: applyToAll is opt-in.

IR-FOP-002 AC-4: state affectedDirectories formula (copy=[destDir], move=destDir+source parents, delete=source parents, no duplicates). Decide error codes DECISION_MISMATCH / INVALID_CHOICE / JOB_NOT_FOUND / JOB_NOT_AWAITING / MANAGER_DISPOSED have no AC — add under IR-FOP-001 AC-4 (decision endpoint).

T-PH002-03: 7 cases green-on-arrival (pin behavior T-PH002-02 already built) accepted; DoD 'nine red' not literally met. T-PH002-04 files[] extended with server/src/services/fileJobs/fileJobRunner.ts for the same-folder-paste conflict.

Throttle interval 112ms (ceil(1000/9)) accepted: timed sends ≤9 per 1s window + the done flush ≤10. In-place move → silent no-op (skip, no question) and file-vs-directory conflict → choices rename/skip only: fixed in a PM follow-up within PH-002.

IR-FOP-002: add to AC-2 the phase values scanning|transferring and that the wire shape carries sessionId (added by WsRouter.sendSessionEvent). AC-3 kind error is declared but only conflict is produced today (error decisions belong with FR-FEX-007).

T-PH003-04 files[] extended with server/src/services/fileJobs/fileJobManager.ts to add a public pending-decision accessor (GET inline pendingDecision, FR-FOP-003 AC-3). Reading private manager.jobs is not acceptable.
The router pathPolicy and the manager deps.validatePathFor must be built from ONE source (same getCwd + blockedPaths), otherwise route and manager can disagree on the same path. Add a wiring guard.

Add a POSITIVE case (tests-first, confirm red): a link whose realpath is INSIDE the source session cwd is followed and its content copied — otherwise 'reject every link' passes the suite (review MEDIUM).

SECURITY: pathValidator.resolveAndValidate returns the unresolved path on ENOENT and never re-checks blocked/traversal on the real path. The existing FileService write/create APIs likely share the hole (write into blocked .git or outside cwd through a junction). Fix at the shared validator (nearest existing ancestor realpath), with tests, so every caller is covered.

SEC-FOP-001: Change Note — runtime confirmed R-06: a file could be written inside a blocked directory or outside the cwd through a junction (fixed in T-PH003-06). Consider stating in AC-2 that links whose real target is inside the cwd are allowed.

Production validatePathFor must use validateCreatePath for BOTH source and destination (validateSessionPath compares against the raw cwd, so a cwd that is itself a link or an 8.3 short name would wrongly refuse every link inside it). Router pathPolicy and manager must share one source.
